storyTitle: Track Holiday Spending Goal via Statement Credits
oneSentenceStory: Review current holiday savings progress and apply accumulated rewards directly to upcoming statement bills.
customerSituation: Customer has accumulated 7,300 LBG coins and reached 53% progress toward their Holiday Spending Money goal.
storyTension: Ensuring clear visibility of tangible cash value without distraction from non-payment partner offers.
customerResolution: Viewing transparent balance allocation and confirming automated statement credit pathways.
primaryOutcome: Effortless tracking and application of statement credits to offset upcoming bills.
